subject: Aurora Cloud – onboarding sequencing & MAP draft
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@auroracloud.com>, Tom Malik <tom.malik@auroracloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Cloud – onboarding sequencing & MAP draft

Elena / Tom,

Great to have Aurora live on the contract. Per our call today I put together a slim mutual action plan (MAP) and an initial sequencing proposal so we can hit production goals without surprises. Attached: Aurora_MAP_v1.3.pdf (high level milestones) and RDW-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx (task checklist).

High level proposal (one-line):
- Kickoff + discovery: week of Aug 9
- Pre-prod environment provision + test data: target Aug 19
- Integration sprint (ingest + auth): Aug 23–Sep 3
- Pilot validation & perf test: Sep 6–10
- Production cutover: Sep 17

As discussed, I will hand the day-to-day coordination to Marissa (CS). Marissa / Grace — can you pick up the execution plan and confirm owners for the checklist items, plus a weekly cadence?

Next steps:
1) Go/No-go on timeline from Aurora by EOD Thu Aug 6.
2) Marissa to schedule kickoff.
3) Dev/infra prerequisites confirmed by our infra lead (cc Dev).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick alignment call if helpful.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0138

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.3.pdf (8 pages); RDW-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx (12 rows)

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@auroracloud.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Tom Malik <tom.malik@auroracloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Cloud – onboarding sequencing & MAP draft

Connor — thanks, this is helpful. Quick confirmations from our side:
- We can do a kickoff the week of Aug 9 (prefer Aug 10 or 11 mornings PT).
- Pre-prod access: we need a minimum 72h notice once you provision.
- Data residency: production must remain in us-west-2. Any temporary testing outside that region needs approval.

Tom and I reviewed the milestones. Two asks: 1) can you add approximate engineering-estimated effort per milestone (dev days), and 2) include a clear owner for each checklist row.

I'll loop in our security contact if you need to exchange artifacts (SOC2 questionnaire). For now here's a short list of documents we need at kickoff: SSO plan, network diagram, and the SOW/ordering doc signed.

Tom — are Aug 10 or 11 mornings OK?

Best,
Elena Torres
VP, Product Operations | Aurora Cloud
elena.torres@auroracloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@auroracloud.com>, Tom Malik <tom.malik@auroracloud.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Cloud – onboarding sequencing & MAP draft

Elena / Tom — thanks and welcome. I picked this up from Connor and attached two artifacts for kickoff: Aurora_MAP_v1.3.pdf (annotated by CS) and RDW-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx (owners column populated).

TL;DR — proposed kickoff: Tue Aug 10, 9:30–10:30 PT (30m internal + 30m joint). Please confirm.

Key milestones with owners and tentative target dates:
- Kickoff + discovery (Marissa) — Aug 10
- Pre-prod provisioning (Dev) — target Aug 19 (72h notice required)
- SSO integration (Grace + Aurora Sec) — Aug 23–26
- Data ingestion connector (Dev) — Aug 23–Aug 30
- First pilot run & validation (CS + Aurora) — Sep 6–9
- Perf tuning & cost optimization (Grace) — Sep 10–14
- Production cutover (Marissa + Connor) — Sep 17

Responsibilities (short):
- Redwood CS (Marissa): project manager, weekly status, acceptance criteria signoff
- Redwood Solutions (Grace): integration design, perf tuning, evals
- Redwood Infra (Dev): pre-prod, secrets, network config, support windows
- Aurora: provide test data, SSO contact, security questionnaires, sign SOW

Open items before kickoff:
1) Signed SOW or initial ordering doc (Connor to chase).
2) Security questionnaire handoff (Aurora to provide contact).
3) Exact pre-prod CIDR and allowed IPs (Aurora to send).

Attached checklist shows owner for each row and an estimate column (dev days). We'll refine estimates on the kickoff call.

On Mon, Aug 3, 2026 at 5:22 PM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena / Tom,
>
> Great to have Aurora live on the contract. Per our call today I put together a slim mutual action plan (MAP) and an initial sequencing proposal so we can hit production goals without surprises. Attached: Aurora_MAP_v1.3.pdf (high level milestones) and RDW-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx (task checklist).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.3.pdf (annotated); RDW-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx (owners, time estimates)

From: Tom Malik <tom.malik@auroracloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@auroracloud.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Cloud – onboarding sequencing & MAP draft

Marissa — thanks for the plan. A couple of clarifying items from engineering:
1) For pre-prod we need clarity on backup/retention settings — can Redwood set retention to 7 days for test data?
2) We will need a short lead time (approx 5 business days) to provide full dataset extracts for validation — can your timeline accommodate that before Aug 23?

Also, we have a security reviewer (Sanjay Mehta) who will want to review the SSO diagram and the SOC2 artifact set. Planning to loop him in after kickoff.

Cc'ing Dev to confirm infra timelines.

Cheers,
Tom Malik
VP, Engineering | Aurora Cloud

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Tom Malik <tom.malik@auroracloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Cloud – onboarding sequencing & MAP draft

Tom / team — thanks, quick infra update and commitments: 
- Pre-prod provisioning: we can provision the preprod cluster in us-west-2 on Aug 19 as targeted. I will post the provisioning window 72h in advance.
- Test data retention: we'll set a 7-day retention on the test environment (matches your ask).
- Lead time for dataset extracts: we can accept your 5 business day cadence; to keep the milestone timeline we'll need the first extract no later than Aug 14 (if you can provide it earlier, great).

Runbook & links: I've uploaded the runbook stub to the shared drive folder and attached Preprod-Access-Reqs.docx to this thread. Also sending an internal DocuSign link for the SOW — Connor, please confirm when you send the ordering doc and I will enable infra access immediately after execution.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Connor: finalize ordering doc + push for signature (today Aug 15).
- Aurora: send SSO contact + CIDR list by EOD Aug 16.
- Marissa: send calendar invite for kickoff (Aug 10 already proposed — if confirmed, please schedule).

On Thu, Aug 12, 2026 at 8:03 AM Tom Malik <tom.malik@auroracloud.com> wrote:
> Marissa — thanks for the plan. A couple of clarifying items from engineering:
> 1) For pre-prod we need clarity on backup/retention settings — can Redwood set retention to 7 days for test data?
> 2) We will need a short lead time (approx 5 business days) to provide full dataset extracts for validation — can your timeline accommodate that before Aug 23?

Regards,
Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: Preprod-Access-Reqs.docx (network/CIDR template); link to runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-Aurora-Onboarding
thread_summary: Sales -> CS handoff where Connor transitions day-to-day ownership to Marissa. MAP attached with milestones and owners; infra lead (Dev) confirms pre-prod provisioning and retention settings. Open items: signed SOW, SSO contact, CIDR list. Kickoff proposed Aug 10; production cutover target Sep 17.
